fixtureStatuses.sql: SELECT status,count(*) FROM statarena.fixtures GROUP BY status ORDER BY status

objectClasses.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN path ~ '\.(webp|png|jpg|jpeg|svg|gif|avif)$' THEN 'images' WHEN path ~ '\.json(l)?(\.gz)?$' THEN 'structured-files' ELSE 'other' END kind,count(*),sum(size),count(body) FROM statarena.objects GROUP BY kind ORDER BY kind

objectPrefixes.sql: SELECT split_part(path,'/',1) prefix,count(*),sum(size) FROM statarena.objects GROUP BY prefix ORDER BY prefix

documentReadiness.sql: SELECT status,count(*) FROM statarena.file_document_sources GROUP BY status ORDER BY status

playerIdentityVersions.sql: SELECT count(*) rows,count(DISTINCT player_id) provider_ids FROM statarena_app.players

appearancePartitionMismatch.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM statarena_app.appearances a JOIN statarena_app.matches m ON m.id=a.match_id WHERE a.season IS DISTINCT FROM m.season OR a.league_id IS DISTINCT FROM m.league_id

fixtureMatchPartitionMismatch.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM statarena_app.fixtures f JOIN statarena_app.matches m ON m.id=f.id WHERE f.season IS DISTINCT FROM m.season OR f.league_id IS DISTINCT FROM m.league_id

workflowState.sql: SELECT workflow,status,remaining,started_at,completed_at,updated_at FROM statarena_app.workflow_state ORDER BY workflow

workerInputKinds.sql: SELECT kind,count(*) FROM statarena_app.worker_inputs GROUP BY kind ORDER BY kind

matchResourcesCoreCoverage.sql: SELECT count(*),count(m.id) FROM statarena_app.match_resources r LEFT JOIN statarena_app.matches m ON m.id=r.match_id
